newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures mixed, selling hits long end.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures mixed, selling hits long end.

text.p: May 22 - U.S. debt futures were mixed, with the long end down on brisk sales. One Swiss bank sold 2,000 June T-bonds, a Wall Street firm sold another 1,000, traders said. They said some disappointment tied to lack of economic comments from Fed's Greenspan's prepared remarks at 0900 CDT/1400 GMT. Traders watch for Q&A. 108-29/32 is June T-bond support.
